notes.title: Patch 0.1.3 - Final
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44027234/adabe1e5b23a0f09c5d6b7ae9e46f33315abb37f.png[/img]
[h1]PREFACE[/h1]
This update is the last for the demo version. The next development pipeline will take place with the main build of the game and without public announcements of updates.

Those who have immediate access to the full version of the game (beta testers and press) will also not receive updates to the build. Development will move to a closed branch. If it is necessary to recruit testers, I will conduct closed recruitments of people on separate closed testing branches.

[h1]PATCHNOTE:[/h1]

[b]FIX ERROR[/b]
• Fixed character collider

[b]GENERAL[/b]
• Settings UI edited
• Added option to change mouse sensitivity

[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]
• Access to gadgets is limited to learning points

[b]AUDIO[/b]
• Adding clothing sounds
• Fixed subtitle timings

[h1]IN CUSTODY[/h1]

I express my deep gratitude for the great attention to the game, for your minutes spent in the demo version and for your pleasant feedback. Based on your feedback, wishes and guided by the original idea, I, as a developer, will do everything possible to ensure that the final product pleases you.

Overall, I was pleased with the result and would like to report some minor successes as a result of the presentation of the Demo version. 1,500 people played the demo, 13,000 people installed the demo version, and 6,100 people added it to their wishlist (at the time of writing the news).

The demo version will not be removed from Steam and will continue to remain public!

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2
notes.content:
[h1]INVENTIONS[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added subtitles in German.
[*] Added Audio setting.
[*] A settings button has been added to the pause menu.
[*] Some sounds have been replaced.
[/list]

[h1]GENERAL[/h1]

[list]
[*] Enabled and adjusted the operation of Vertical synchronization, selection of window mode and resolution.
[*] Hand position has been corrected. The hand behavior code was also completely rewritten, which corrected errors with the appearance of duplicate items in the hands. Now you can turn on the flashlight using objects in your hands, such as: UV Flashlight, Thermal Imager.
[*] Doors cannot be opened with your back. Now the interactivity button only appears when looking at an object.
[*] Fixed errors where audio tracks were overlapped.
[*] Work has been done on post-processing for optimization purposes.
[*] Work is underway on optimization. Removed or reworked objects that had a large number of polygons or were taxing on the CPU.
[*] Minor work to improve the location.
[*] Reduced texture resolution to 2k resolution.
[*] In the previous version, the entire load was placed on the Central Processor, the video card practically did not participate in the calculations. In the current patch, the load will be evenly distributed between the Central Processor and Video Card.
[/list]

[h1]CORRECTIONS[/h1]

[list]
[*] Doors now push when opening/closing.
[*] Fixed a bug where hands were visible in the Thermal Imager.
[*] Subtitle timings have been corrected.
[*] Fixing small, minor bugs.
[*] The volume level of all audio tracks has been equalized.
[/list]

[h3]Tips for increasing productivity:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Do not use a screen resolution higher than 2K.
[*] Update your video card driver and check if you have DirectX 12 installed.
[/list]

notes.title: DEMO COMING SOON
notes.content:
[h1]EARLY ACCESS[/h1]
Hello! I would like to tell you in advance about my plans for Early Access. As you may have noticed, the game will not be released immediately, but in Early Access. This is due to the fact that I am developing the project alone and it would take a lot of time to complete all my plans for the game.

I don’t want to reveal all the plans and ideas regarding the storyline, but I can say that the Early Access version will not be limited by content. Both in terms of mechanics and plot.

[h1]MECHANICS, COOPERATIVES and STORY[/h1]
Since there were many questions about these items, I decided to give them a place in the news digest. There are a lot of mechanics planned for the game, both familiar to everyone from the game [u]Phasmophobia[/u], and new ones. The main principle of the game mechanics is the search for paranormal activity.

[b]Cooperative?[/b] No. Online and co-op are not provided in the game and will not be added, even in the release version. So, the game is planned and developed for a single story adventure. This is a full-fledged story-oriented game.

[b]As for the plot.[/b] The plot is written by an individual with experience and already released projects in the genre of horror games.

[h1]DEMO VERSION[/h1]
The release of the public Demo version is scheduled for October 9, 2023! The demo version will feature a short excerpt of the storyline and some game mechanics will be available. Also follow our YouTube channels. So, for the release of the Demo version, we have prepared a special new trailer!

Good luck everyone, thank you for your attention and add the game to your wishlist!
